description: Pass/fail thresholds for the AED dedup fixture pack. Dev is used for calibration, holdout only for release reporting.

splits.holdout_rule: Do not tune weights or thresholds after inspecting holdout results. Move a failing case to dev, recalibrate, and re-freeze a new holdout.

fail_conditions: Any expected cluster differs from the produced cluster as a set of record keys.
Any expected pair decision differs, or the score falls outside the declared range.
Any auto_merge or same_entity decision has hard_conflict=true unless the fixture explicitly expects review.
Any hard identity conflict is silently merged without a review item.
Any expected review item is missing, has a different severity, or a blocking item is downgraded.
Any canonical field differs from the expected value, or its provenance is missing or wrong.
The same case produces a different cluster or review set under record-order permutation.
A validation issue is missing, has a different code, or a public AED is emitted for a blocked record.
provenance_completeness is below 1.0 for any merged record.
A rerun of the same fixture produces a new AED row, alias, or review item.

report_contract.output: JSON artifact attached to CI; one artifact per split.
